name: Rania Haddad
scenario_title: An Interruption at the Kitchen Table
action: Rania sets down the bread, rises from the table, and invites the student inside to sit, offering to look at his draft.
reason: Rania's established tendency is to set aside her own work and welcome students with last-minute requests, as seen in her repeated rearrangements of translation hours and her refusal to turn away anyone with a notebook. Her body half-rising before thinking and her memory of his broken printer reinforce that she will immediately prioritize his thesis over her evening translation work.
